title: contacts-server: AddressBook name/description localizable; ContactCard excluded
description:
jmap-contacts-server (with contacts-types): AddressBook `name` and `description` are localizable.
- name: not nullable. description: nullable; a null localized value means no description in that language.
- ContactCard is excluded: it keeps JSContact's own language/localizations (RFC 9553 2.1.5, 2.7.1), and `language` on ContactCard/get is invalidArguments.
Follows the mail-server pattern (previous child).
close_reason: AddressBook name/description localizable: type fields, /set checks, memory backend pruning; /get via handle_get_with_metadata; ContactCard excluded; 5 tests incl. draft Appendix A
